name: Instagram follow — the press beat
description: Creator platform block (brief: instagram-follow), vertical-first for Reels: a pack-immune, platform-faithful Instagram profile card over transparent footage — story-ring gradient avatar, username, meta — whose blue Follow button presses to Following at the 0.42 beat (140ms dip, swap, 420ms one-shot card settle; both button states share one grid cell so the card never reflows). Faithful artifact per ADR-0038: the Instagram gradient/blue consume no Pack roles and render pixel-identical under every Pack — intentionally no collage/grit chrome. A derived pop cue fires at the press; the footage keeps its own audio otherwise.
